CREATE VIEW a_stg_store_sales AS
SELECT
  ss.ss_ticket_number,
  ss.ss_item_sk,
  ss.ss_customer_sk,
  ss.ss_store_sk,
  ss.ss_promo_sk,
  d.d_date AS sale_date,
  d.d_year,
  d.d_moy,
  d.d_qoy,
  COALESCE(ss.ss_quantity, 0) AS quantity,
  COALESCE(ss.ss_net_paid, 0) AS net_paid,
  COALESCE(ss.ss_net_paid_inc_tax, 0) AS net_paid_inc_tax,
  COALESCE(ss.ss_net_profit, 0) AS net_profit,
  COALESCE(ss.ss_coupon_amt, 0) AS coupon_amt,
  IFF(ss.ss_customer_sk IS NULL, 'anonymous', 'known') AS customer_kind
FROM store_sales AS ss
JOIN date_dim AS d
  ON d.d_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk
WHERE
  d.d_year IN (2000, 2001)

CREATE VIEW a_stg_item AS
SELECT
  i_item_sk,
  i_item_id,
  UPPER(TRIM(i_category)) AS category,
  UPPER(TRIM(i_class)) AS class,
  COALESCE(i_brand, 'UNBRANDED') AS brand,
  i_current_price,
  CASE
    WHEN i_current_price < 10
    THEN 'low'
    WHEN i_current_price < 50
    THEN 'mid'
    ELSE 'high'
  END AS price_band,
  CAST(i_manufact_id AS VARCHAR) AS manufact_id
FROM item
WHERE
  NOT i_current_price IS NULL

CREATE VIEW a_stg_customer AS
SELECT
  c.c_customer_sk,
  c.c_customer_id,
  CONCAT_WS(' ', COALESCE(c.c_first_name, ''), COALESCE(c.c_last_name, '')) AS full_name,
  cd.cd_gender AS gender,
  cd.cd_marital_status AS marital,
  cd.cd_education_status AS education,
  2001 - c.c_birth_year AS age_2001,
  CASE
    WHEN 2001 - c.c_birth_year < 30
    THEN 'under30'
    WHEN 2001 - c.c_birth_year < 50
    THEN '30to49'
    ELSE '50plus'
  END AS age_band,
  ca.ca_state AS state,
  ca.ca_country AS country
FROM customer AS c
LEFT JOIN customer_demographics AS cd
  ON cd.cd_demo_sk = c.c_current_cdemo_sk
LEFT JOIN customer_address AS ca
  ON ca.ca_address_sk = c.c_current_addr_sk

CREATE VIEW a_stg_returns AS
SELECT
  sr.sr_ticket_number,
  sr.sr_item_sk,
  sr.sr_customer_sk,
  sr.sr_store_sk,
  d.d_year,
  d.d_moy,
  COALESCE(sr.sr_return_quantity, 0) AS return_qty,
  COALESCE(sr.sr_return_amt, 0) AS return_amt,
  DATEDIFF(DAY, TO_DATE(d0.d_date), TO_DATE(d.d_date)) AS days_to_return
FROM store_returns AS sr
JOIN date_dim AS d
  ON d.d_date_sk = sr.sr_returned_date_sk
JOIN store_sales AS ss
  ON ss.ss_ticket_number = sr.sr_ticket_number AND ss.ss_item_sk = sr.sr_item_sk
JOIN date_dim AS d0
  ON d0.d_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk
WHERE
  d.d_year IN (2000, 2001)

    ON ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
  WHERE
    wr_order_number IS NULL
  GROUP BY
    d_year,
    ws_item_sk,
    ws_bill_customer_sk
), cs AS (
  SELECT
    d_year AS cs_sold_year,
    cs_item_sk,
    cs_bill_customer_sk AS cs_customer_sk,
    SUM(cs_quantity) AS cs_qty,
    SUM(cs_wholesale_cost) AS cs_wc,
    SUM(cs_sales_price) AS cs_sp
  FROM catalog_sales
  LEFT JOIN catalog_returns
    ON cr_order_number = cs_order_number AND cs_item_sk = cr_item_sk
  JOIN date_dim
    ON cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
  WHERE
    cr_order_number IS NULL
  GROUP BY
    d_year,
    cs_item_sk,
    cs_bill_customer_sk
), ss AS (
  SELECT
    d_year AS ss_sold_year,
    ss_item_sk,
    ss_customer_sk,
    SUM(ss_quantity) AS ss_qty,
    SUM(ss_wholesale_cost) AS ss_wc,
    SUM(ss_sales_price) AS ss_sp

  LEFT JOIN store_returns
    ON sr_ticket_number = ss_ticket_number AND ss_item_sk = sr_item_sk
  JOIN date_dim

    ss_item_sk,

)
SELECT

  ss_customer_sk,
  ROUND(
    (
      ss_qty * 1.00
    ) / NULLIF((
      COALESCE(ws_qty, 0) + COALESCE(cs_qty, 0)
    ), 0),
    2
  ) AS ratio,
  ss_qty AS store_qty,
  ss_wc AS store_wholesale_cost,
  ss_sp AS store_sales_price,
  COALESCE(ws_qty, 0) + COALESCE(cs_qty, 0) AS other_chan_qty,
  COALESCE(ws_wc, 0) + COALESCE(cs_wc, 0) AS other_chan_wholesale_cost,
  COALESCE(ws_sp, 0) + COALESCE(cs_sp, 0) AS other_chan_sales_price
FROM ss

  ON (
    ws_sold_year = ss_sold_year
    AND ws_item_sk = ss_item_sk
    AND ws_customer_sk = ss_customer_sk
  )
LEFT JOIN cs
  ON (
    cs_sold_year = ss_sold_year
    AND cs_item_sk = ss_item_sk
    AND cs_customer_sk = ss_customer_sk
  )
WHERE
  (
    COALESCE(ws_qty, 0) > 0 OR COALESCE(cs_qty, 0) > 0
  ) AND ss_sold_year = 2000

  ss_sold_year,
  ss_item_sk,
  ss_customer_sk,
  ss_qty DESC NULLS LAST,
  ss_wc DESC NULLS LAST,
